name: Chaos Rush cast mid-jump while running forward still dashes forward (#9874)
contract: Chaos Rush 500422 triggers Chaos Rush Jump 802028: effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE_DEST to TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT with radius 10 yd, tooltip 'dash forward in the direction you're running'. A grounded caster holding a movement key gets a run-speed surge instead of the forced spline (#9397/#9404), but an airborne client keeps its take-off horizontal speed for the whole jump, so a surge during a running jump moves it nowhere. A running jump carries forward plus falling: the cast must keep the native 10 yd charge, exactly like a standing jump, and must not surge the run speed. The movement flags are fixtured through the harness, so this proves the server takes the charge path; the client-side jump arc needs a real client.
